questions: Section 16 refers combinations of cardiac risk factors to judgement but does not say which findings count. For that purpose, does house practice treat each of the following as a cardiac risk factor even where its own table charges 0 or only 25: a BMI in the 28.0-30.9 band, an A1c of 5.7-6.4 with no diabetes diagnosis, and an HDL under 40 with the TC/HDL ratio still at 5.0 or under?

When two or more such cardiac risk factors sit on one file and none of them is individually rated above 25 debits, what does house practice do with the rating - add a fixed combination debit, move the total up one class, restrict the best available class, or leave the arithmetic exactly as the individual tables give it?

Section 5 rates only total cholesterol and the TC/HDL ratio. Does house practice attach any debit or class restriction to a low HDL (under 40) on its own when total cholesterol and the ratio both fall in the 0 bands?
